name: mps-bay-2a

validation_hypothesis: Test whether candidate exposure produces differential mitotic arrest/checkpoint phenotypes in a BUB1B-deficient model versus an isogenic control.
bub1b_relation: High mechanistic compatibility with the BUB1B LoF hypothesis. BUB1B participates in spindle assembly checkpoint control; MPS1/TTK is a pharmacologically perturbable node within this mitotic checkpoint network.
research_interpretation: Priority hypothesis because MPS1/TTK is a mitotic checkpoint node compatible with the BUB1B LoF hypothesis. Dataset status: PRECLINICAL. This ranking represents a research hypothesis and not evidence of therapeutic efficacy.
trinova_validation_hypothesis: Test mps-bay-2a in a BUB1B LoF-relevant cellular model and measure spindle assembly checkpoint integrity, mitotic duration, chromosome mis-segregation and cell viability.
